title: Add a third-party license notices inventory to TermAl, as Engram has
outcome: TermAl ships a THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES file listing the licenses of its resolved Cargo and npm dependencies, in the same form as Engram's, so distributed builds carry the required attributions.
acceptance: THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt at the repository root inventories every external package version resolved by Cargo.lock and ui/package-lock.json, with each package's license and attribution reference, generated by a documented, repeatable command, and states that it does not relicense third-party components.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
